annotations.title: Get Team Statuses Across All Year Events

description: Retrieve a team's per-event status for every event the team attended in a given year, returned as an object keyed by event_key. Each entry mirrors get_team_event_status (rank, alliance, playoff progression, summary strings, next/last match key). Use to render a season status dashboard in one call.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.

year.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

name: get_team_event_statuses
